title: Retire reviewer's fable pin → inherit (default main model)
description:
Fable 5 is no longer available to this account (session-limit lockout, 2026-06-12). The reviewer agent's frontmatter pins model: fable, which now FAILS to spawn. Human directive: the reviewer (and the orchestrator, which already inherits as the main thread) must run on the default main model going forward.

DECISION (locked): reviewer model fable → `inherit`, NOT a hard `opus` pin. Rationale: 'default main model' = the session model; inherit tracks whatever the session runs on (currently Opus 4.8, the new account default), so the independent quality gate keeps running on the strongest model available without re-pinning every time the default moves. developer + researcher STAY on sonnet (unaffected — they never used fable; the 'can't use fable' reason doesn't touch them).

SCOPE (grep to find every coupling — these are the known sites):
(a) .claude/agents/reviewer.md AND agents/reviewer.md (parity copy): model: fable → model: inherit, byte-identical (agents-parity spec locks this).
(b) CLAUDE.md '## Per-Agent Model Assignment': the reviewer bullet (fable → inherit/default-main-model + updated rationale: gate runs on the session's main model, currently Opus 4.8); the orchestrator bullet ('Fable 5 in production' → 'Opus 4.8 in production'); keep developer/researcher = sonnet.
(c) tests/agent-models.spec.js: the assertion pinning /^model:\s*fable\s*$/m on reviewer.md → inherit; the doc-section test that requires reviewer+fable co-occurrence → reviewer+inherit (or default-main-model wording). Rename describe/it labels off 'fable' where they hardcode it.
(d) verification-policy-docs.spec.js (~line 274) and tests/e2e/agent-models-config.spec.js: update any assertion that the model section mentions reviewer+fable. The e2e applier spec uses tmp fixtures — confirm it does NOT pin the real reviewer.md to fable; if it does, fix.
(e) Do NOT change the --apply-models applier logic, the valid-alias list (fable stays a VALID alias — it's just not what we assign now), or the agent_models PROJECT.md knob. This is a value change, not a mechanism change.

No PROJECT.md exists in the dev repo, so --apply-models is not the mechanism here — edit the frontmatter directly (both parity copies).
acceptance_criteria: Both reviewer.md copies (.claude/agents/ and plugin-root agents/) carry model: inherit, byte-identical; developer.md and researcher.md remain model: sonnet in both copies.

CLAUDE.md '## Per-Agent Model Assignment' documents reviewer → inherit (default main model) with updated rationale, and the orchestrator bullet reflects Opus 4.8 as the production session model; no other agent's assignment changed.

All model-policy specs (tests/agent-models.spec.js, verification-policy-docs.spec.js, tests/e2e/agent-models-config.spec.js) updated to the new expected values and GREEN; no spec still asserts reviewer == fable.
fable remains a valid alias in the --apply-models validation list and the applier logic is untouched (value change only, not mechanism).
Full release gate green (npm run test:all) since model-policy + test-infra files change; agents-parity spec passes.

comments.body: PLAN-TIME TIER ASSIGNMENT: verification_tier = tdd. NOTE: during the transition, the orchestrator spawns ALL reviewers this session with an explicit model:opus override so the stale fable pin cannot block review; after this ticket lands, inherit resolves to the session default automatically.
